description: Ground truth for microrealestate/microrealestate (root docker-compose.yml), hand-verified against gateway proxy code, service route/client code, and compose env wiring. The Next.js frontends (webapps/*) call the gateway via DOCKER_GATEWAY_URL but live outside the inferrable service dirs — their outbound edges are listed as known misses, not counted in the gate.

knownMisses.why: Next.js app in webapps/, outside service-dir inference

traps: gateway env has EMAILER_URL wired but the code never proxies it — no gateway->emailer edge
RESETSERVICE_URL proxy exists in code but is unwired in compose — no gateway->resetservice edge
GATEWAY_URL on frontends points at the public localhost URL, not an internal service
